59GEMSDOE.title: 59GEMSDOE — Intensity Lane (H59-I2)
59GEMSDOE.description: DOE GEMS Prize intensity lane. Its README reports download OK and submit OK for the current candidate (verdict 'promote', 0 weekly slots spent automatically) and labels its headline 4-fold pooled holdout score 0.166789 [0.153242, 0.179658] as HOLDOUT-DTI rather than an organizer-confirmed competition score, stating that the lower 95% CI bound exceeds the previously published all-lane best's upper bound. It also reports a monotonically increasing 1 km block decile calibration over 52,309 footprint blocks (78.25% of withheld pixels in the top 3 deciles), a leakage canary with 0 flags across 31 covariates, and a uniqueness audit against 695 rasters plus its predecessor lane. The directory repeats the repository's own labels and numbers and does not verify them.
